verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own marketing claims AI-powered chat and search, and says Rovo can be used in the terminal or IDE. That suggests a natural-language interface exists, but nothing shows users can actually run product operations (creating PRs, managing repos, triggering pipelines) through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: documentation of natural-language command execution against Bitbucket actions, details of the chat interface's scope and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Reduce cycle times across the development lifecycle with AI-powered search, chat, code review, pipeline triage, and even Jira updates.
Access the latest models with Rovo — in your terminal or in your IDE.
